title: Companies Act, 2013 — private-company meeting exemptions under section 462

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
content.citation: Notification G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, read with G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017
content.note: Official MCA notification material identifies the private-company modifications for sections 101–107 and the later eligibility condition: the section 462 exceptions/modifications/adaptations apply only to a private company that has not defaulted in filing its financial statements under section 137 or annual return under section 92. The current notification text, later amendments, company eligibility and applicable articles must be checked before relying on a particular modification. This is a source attachment and scoped review, not final legal sign-off.
